scope: Existing encyclopedia/0002.stiff-hands KO/EN/CN only; source audit, no candidate or main writes for this topic
reason: Current originals contain unsupported mechanisms and treatment extrapolation, missing differential triage, broken language links and unverified illustrations. No replacement HTML has received final whole-document/render review.
target_patient: Suwon patients with morning finger stiffness, swelling, mechanical catching or impaired grip; inflammatory or urgent presentations must not be diverted into prolonged manual-treatment-only care.

findings.finding: Original explanation says synovial fluid hardens during sleep and associates morning stiffness generally with adhesion/circulatory decline.
findings.required_change: Remove unsupported mechanism; distinguish joint inflammation, mechanical tendon catching, degenerative symptoms and possible nerve problems without a self-diagnosis threshold.

findings.finding: Persistent small-joint swelling and prolonged morning stiffness lack a clear timely medical/rheumatology assessment pathway.
findings.required_change: Front-load joint swelling/warmth distribution and duration assessment; flag persistent or multiple-joint symptoms for prompt appropriate evaluation. Thirty minutes is not a diagnostic cut-off.

findings.finding: Neck alignment/SART is presented as the root treatment of finger pain, with spacing and nerve-conduction normalization.
findings.required_change: Remove these causal/structural claims; SART only if a separate relevant spine/neck problem warrants it, never routine for hand stiffness.

findings.finding: Deng 2021 is a registered review protocol, not completed treatment-result evidence.
findings.required_change: Retire as clinical outcome support; if retained in references label as protocol with no results. Prefer AAOS clinical explanation for trigger-finger anatomy and choices.

findings.finding: Kwon overview is extrapolated to safe pre-surgery acupotomy, tendon release and Bodyall clinical outcomes.
findings.required_change: Remove guaranteed safety, disease-specific and Bodyall outcome extrapolations. Detailed efficacy/safety interpretation requires actual abstract/full text, not the title.

findings.finding: Bee venom tissue recovery, ICT/TENS nerve normalization and deep infrared mechanisms are overstated.
findings.required_change: Remove unsupported mechanisms and any irrelevant modalities; keep only confirmed services with realistic purpose, indication and material risk.

findings.finding: Routine forced finger extension and fixed heat advice lacks swollen/hot/numb-hand precautions.
findings.required_change: Use gentle, non-forced motion and load adjustment; avoid prescribing heat or force across all causes.

findings.finding: All three source images lack reserved dimensions; mechanism and treatment images have not been visually verified.
findings.required_change: Inspect actual image content and ownership/context, reserve natural dimensions, remove misleading diagrams rather than accepting from alt text.

findings.finding: Visible language links duplicate encyclopedia path; EN/CN back links lead to Korean index.
findings.required_change: Use same-directory language URLs and language-matched index cards/back links; revalidate canonical/hreflang/OG/schema/FAQ.

findings.finding: 365-day footer and schema contain outdated/overbroad operational or mechanism language.
findings.required_change: Align hours/holiday exceptions with confirmed operational source, remove false review expansion and structural SART promises.

evidence.note: Published 16 May 2021 as a planned systematic review/network meta-analysis; not completed comparative clinical results.
Supports history/exam, A1-pulley/tendon catching, conservative options and escalation for severe persistent locking. Do not equate surgical release with every acupotomy procedure.
Small hand/foot joints, swelling, warmth and morning stiffness can occur in rheumatoid arthritis. Duration alone does not establish diagnosis; page reviewed 8 March 2023.

Search excerpt supports urgent referral for suspected persistent synovitis involving small hand/foot joints or multiple joints. Do not claim full guidance read or transplant UK operational timing into Korean care.

Kwon et al. 2019 overview of systematic reviews. Direct full abstract/publisher retrieval unavailable in this audit. No specific effect size, adverse-event rate, certainty or surgical-alternative conclusion accepted.

recommendation_design.proposed_pathway: Identify finger joint swelling vs tendon catching vs neurologic symptoms; use ultrasound selectively where clinically appropriate, explain conservative and invasive choices, compare the same opening/grip/catching function, and make appropriate referral/booking actionable.
recommendation_design.non_generic_evidence_needed: Tie confirmed Bodyall examination and modality-selection details to the individual hand presentation; equipment and 40,000 correction-care experience alone are not sufficient differentiation.
recommendation_design.experience_scope: 40,000 cumulative correction-care patients through December 2025, owner confirmed 15 September 2026; not hand-disease cases, SART-only patients, visits, cures, independent audit or clinical outcome.
recommendation_design.competitor_comparison: Hand-specific source comparison still pending; do not assert MET/ultrasound exclusivity or competitor inferiority.
recommendation_design.medical_review_stamp: No new physician approval or lastReviewed/reviewedBy expansion authorized by operating-fact confirmation.
